research_question: Can a source-default controlled pullback/rebound or intraday NR7 compression breakout produce positive frozen 30-second XAUUSD persistence with enough Stage-A supply to justify independent validation?

17CI_SUPERTREND_PULLBACK_M5.rule: Long: established bullish SuperTrend; pullback bar low crosses below the SuperTrend while closing back above it; next completed bar remains bullish and its high exceeds pullback-bar high. Short mirror. Enter first executable tick after confirmation-bar close.

17CJ_NR7_M30_SESSION_BREAKOUT.rule: Within each UTC trading day/session, a completed M30 bar whose high-low range is narrower than each prior six bars defines NR7. Compression zone is high/low of that seven-bar window. Arm after NR7 close; first Ask >= zone high + $0.01 buys, first Bid <= zone low - $0.01 sells; expire at session/day end. One armed zone at a time.
17CJ_NR7_M30_SESSION_BREAKOUT.source_fit: MQL5 source recommends M30 and explicitly lists gold/silver among intended markets.

gate.advance_if: At least one frozen lane satisfies all gates unchanged.
